scope: Offline kit and synthetic fixture validation, plus independent instruction-level review. No fresh-account deployment was executed by the package author.
independent_review_fixes: Runtime references now travel inside the skill package; Drive deployments must rebind relative links to verified installed file links.
Recovery and overlap require verified serialization, recoverable worker/session handles, status checks and safe handling of unknown workers.
Local validation prerequisites and dependency installation are documented.
note: Checks validate the kit files and the published synthetic fixture; they do not measure the translation quality of a new book.
